artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2024 and 2025, NVDA continues to emphasize security and supply_chain as core risk exposure (2024 para 160; 2025 para 109). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in security, while the later filing adds clearer weight to supply_chain (2024 para 37; 2025 para 122). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2024 para 160; 2025 para 122). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2024 para 37; 2025 para 109). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2024 para 160; 2025 para 109).
